CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_market_risk(
    p_dlyflow bigint,
    p_esccomprate numeric,
    p_interscore numeric,
    p_vendcount integer,
    p_mktspan integer
) RETURNS numeric AS $$
BEGIN
    RETURN 
        CAST(p_dlyflow AS numeric) / 1000.0 
        + (p_esccomprate * 0.2) 
        + (p_interscore * 0.3) 
        + (CAST(p_vendcount AS numeric) * 0.1) 
        - CAST(p_mktspan AS numeric) / 100.0;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
